title: Headless Old World Blues Sonic Emitter Upgrade chain (OldWorldBlues.esm): X-8 as the Old World Blues chain walks it, the Advanced Test, the EM pulse module download, a force field hit with the upgraded emitter; docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: The first part is the Old World Blues chain's own (old-world-blues.actions.json) through X-8 (NVDLC03MQ03 100); X-8's tests also carry Sonic Emitter Upgrade (NVDLC03SonicEmitterQuest) to 50.

New game, the player out of Doc Mitchell's house (VCG01 done). Five seconds after leaving it the add-on's quest script shows its two loaded messages and sets Midnight Science-Fiction Feature! (NVDLC03MQ00) 10. Travel stand-in: move_player to the Mojave Drive-in's map marker.
The crashed satellite's object script plays the movie between 23:00 and 03:00 (bMoviePlaying); the clock is set to 23:30 (stand-in for waiting until midnight).

The player activates the crashed satellite: its message box, button 1 (go) sets NVDLC03MQ00 100 (MenuMode 1001), starts the teleport effect and the intro quest; the teleport moves the player into the intro slideshow room.

actions.label: milestone: MQ00 done (the satellite takes the player to Big MT)

actions.text: The slideshow trigger (OnTriggerEnter: physics sensors stand in) starts the narrator's intro slides; the narrator's SayToDone chain ends with NVDLC03TransitionToBigEmpty, which moves the player to the start marker in the Think Tank.
The start trigger at the Think Tank (walked into: stand-in) sets Welcome to the Big Empty (NVDLC03MQ01) 10: organs removed, a message box.

The player activates Dr. Klein: the brain bot's OnActivate calls StartConversation. The Think Tank's first greeting chain (Say Once) ends after the rude choice (Topic044); talking again opens the second chain.

The first chain's last line (INFO 0x010134D9) starts quest 0x01013F1F, whose GameMode (SCPT 0x01013F20) runs `0x01010716.Activate player`: the brain bot, a talking activator, then talks itself (GREETING 0x01013F1B, then topic 0x01010710, ending on a Goodbye line). The player activates Dr. Klein again after it.
Each of the next two choices shows the Brainless, then the Heartless and Spineless message boxes during the lines (dismissed as they open).
Agreeing to help: the end of INFO 0101355E sets NVDLC03MQ01 100 and starts X-2, X-8 and X-13 (NVDLC03MQ02/03/04 10).

actions.label: milestone: MQ01 done (the Think Tank sends the player after the three technologies)

actions.text: X-2: Strange Transmissions! The satellite station trigger (walked into: stand-in) sets 20; the antenna's OnActivate gives the antenna and sets NVDLC03MQ02 100.

X-8: High School Horror! The X-8 trigger sets 20; the test terminal's school test (sub menu item 0) sets 25; the three desk terminals add the three student records (Add Note items) and the quest script sets 30 when all three are held (its 5 s delay).

Leaving the school through the tunnel trigger sets 40; the test terminal's residential test sets 50; the cave's code box (its object script runs when the player is there) sets 60 and hides the bark recording in one of seven random dig spots.

Stand-in for the player searching the dig spots (containers) and taking what is in them: remove_all_items from each of the seven to the player. The recording's message box holds the quest script until it is closed; then its 7 s timer sets NVDLC03MQ03 100. The cyberdog fight is not run.

actions.label: milestone: MQ03 done (X-8 Sonic Emitter frequency)

actions.text: The Advanced Test is offered to a player carrying a Sonic Emitter (the terminal entry's GetItemCount conditions); the emitter Gabe guards in X-8 is given here (add_item: the cyberdog fight and its loot are not run).
In the advanced school, the Field Disrupter Download Terminal (its sub menu's first entry) sets bSonicEmitterUpgraded and 70.
A force field hit with the upgraded emitter (OnHitWith the sonic weapon list): Sonic Emitter Upgrade 100. The hit is the runner's hit op (the shot is a stand-in).
